glossary.definition: "Large water-works or sewage disposal system company" means a water-works or sewage disposal system company that has annual operating revenues of two hundred fifty thousand dollars or more.
glossary.normalized: large water-works or sewage disposal system company
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4909.052 to 4909.055 of the Revised Code:
glossary.term: Large water-works or sewage disposal system company

glossary.definition: "Municipal water-works or sewage disposal system company" means any water-works or sewage disposal system company owned or operated by a political subdivision defined in section 6119.011 of the Revised Code or by a municipal corporation.
glossary.normalized: municipal water-works or sewage disposal system company
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4909.052 to 4909.055 of the Revised Code:
glossary.term: Municipal water-works or sewage disposal system company
